description: DFSMN speech activity detection with offline and causal Stream-VAD checkpoints.

request.name: threshold
request.description: Speech probability threshold; defaults to 0.4 for VAD and 0.5 for Stream-VAD.

request.name: smooth_window_ms
request.description: Trailing probability smoothing window in milliseconds, rounded to the nearest 10 ms. Validation occurs after conversion to 10-ms frames; metadata bounds describe intended settings.

request.name: min_speech_duration_ms
request.description: Speech confirmation duration, rounded to the nearest 10 ms; defaults to 200 ms for VAD and 80 ms for Stream-VAD. Validation occurs after conversion to 10-ms frames; metadata bounds describe intended settings.

request.name: max_speech_duration_sec
request.description: Maximum speech duration in seconds, rounded to the nearest 10 ms. Validation occurs after conversion to 10-ms frames; metadata bounds describe intended settings.

request.name: min_silence_duration_ms
request.description: Silence confirmation duration in milliseconds, rounded to the nearest 10 ms. Validation occurs after conversion to 10-ms frames; metadata bounds describe intended settings.

request.name: merge_silence_duration_ms
request.description: Merge shorter internal silence gaps in offline VAD; milliseconds rounded to the nearest 10 ms.

request.name: speech_pad_ms
request.description: Extend offline VAD segments on each side; milliseconds rounded to the nearest 10 ms.

request.name: speech_start_pad_ms
request.description: Stream-VAD start padding in milliseconds, rounded to the nearest 10 ms and at least the smoothing window.

request.name: audio_chunk_duration_sec
request.description: Maximum network duration per offline chunk in seconds, rounded to the nearest 10 ms; each chunk resets network history, matching upstream.

description.en: FireRed VAD offline checkpoint for speech activity detection on 16 kHz mono audio.
description.zh: FireRed VAD 离线权重，用于整段 16 kHz 单声道音频的语音活动检测。

description.en: FireRed Stream-VAD causal checkpoint for streaming speech activity detection with speech-start/end events.
description.zh: FireRed Stream-VAD 因果权重，用于流式语音活动检测，并输出语音开始/结束事件。

description.en: DFSMN speech activity detection with offline and causal Stream-VAD checkpoints.
description.zh: 基于 DFSMN 的语音活动检测，提供离线与因果流式（Stream-VAD）权重。

threshold.en: Speech probability threshold; defaults to 0.4 for VAD and 0.5 for Stream-VAD.
threshold.zh: 语音概率阈值；VAD 默认 0.4，Stream-VAD 默认 0.5。

smooth_window_ms.en: Trailing probability smoothing window in milliseconds, rounded to the nearest 10 ms. Validation occurs after conversion to 10-ms frames; metadata bounds describe intended settings.
smooth_window_ms.zh: 尾部概率平滑窗口（毫秒），四舍五入到最近的 10 ms。校验在转换为 10 ms 帧后进行；元数据边界表示推荐设置。

min_speech_duration_ms.en: Speech confirmation duration, rounded to the nearest 10 ms; defaults to 200 ms for VAD and 80 ms for Stream-VAD. Validation occurs after conversion to 10-ms frames; metadata bounds describe intended settings.
min_speech_duration_ms.zh: 确认语音所需的时长，四舍五入到最近的 10 ms；VAD 默认 200 ms，Stream-VAD 默认 80 ms。校验在转换为 10 ms 帧后进行；元数据边界表示推荐设置。

max_speech_duration_sec.en: Maximum speech duration in seconds, rounded to the nearest 10 ms. Validation occurs after conversion to 10-ms frames; metadata bounds describe intended settings.
max_speech_duration_sec.zh: 最大语音时长（秒），四舍五入到最近的 10 ms。校验在转换为 10 ms 帧后进行；元数据边界表示推荐设置。

min_silence_duration_ms.en: Silence confirmation duration in milliseconds, rounded to the nearest 10 ms. Validation occurs after conversion to 10-ms frames; metadata bounds describe intended settings.
min_silence_duration_ms.zh: 确认静音所需的时长（毫秒），四舍五入到最近的 10 ms。校验在转换为 10 ms 帧后进行；元数据边界表示推荐设置。

merge_silence_duration_ms.en: Merge shorter internal silence gaps in offline VAD; milliseconds rounded to the nearest 10 ms.
merge_silence_duration_ms.zh: 离线 VAD 中合并较短的内部静音间隔；毫秒四舍五入到最近的 10 ms。

speech_pad_ms.en: Extend offline VAD segments on each side; milliseconds rounded to the nearest 10 ms.
speech_pad_ms.zh: 向离线 VAD 片段两侧扩展；毫秒四舍五入到最近的 10 ms。

speech_start_pad_ms.en: Stream-VAD start padding in milliseconds, rounded to the nearest 10 ms and at least the smoothing window.
speech_start_pad_ms.zh: Stream-VAD 起始填充（毫秒），四舍五入到最近的 10 ms，且不小于平滑窗口。

audio_chunk_duration_sec.en: Maximum network duration per offline chunk in seconds, rounded to the nearest 10 ms; each chunk resets network history, matching upstream.
audio_chunk_duration_sec.zh: 离线分块的最大网络时长（秒），四舍五入到最近的 10 ms；每个分块都会重置网络历史，与上游一致。
